description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Iraxxa trigger, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
